QuestInfo.name: Maple's Got Talent
QuestInfo.0: Triple Volt are still not giving up. Ask Vicky about what they've got in store next.
QuestInfo.1: It's so hard to find an actual entry ticket that Vicky is literally passing out. The search must go on! Let her rest and hunt some Melon Bubble Teas to find 60 VIP Audition Scratch Cards.
QuestInfo.2: Victory! You finally found an Audition Pass.

0.0: Poor Vicky... I didn't realize she wanted to be a singer this bad... Well, maybe if I help her get that audition pass, she'll finally fall into my waiting arms! Hey, you. Can you help?
0.1: Get #b60#k #rVIP Audition Scratchcards#k from #rMelon Bubble Teas#k. That'll get us in for sure!

yes.0: Great! You're the best, kid. I'll leave you to it. Remember, you need to hunt #rMelon Bubble Teas#k. I'll try to get Vicky awake by the time you finish.

no.0: Look, Vicky just fainted, okay? We need these ASAP!

8.msg: Yes yes yes YESSSS!!! Finally! A winning ticket! I finally get to be in the audition! WOO-HOO!!

9.msg: OMG I'M SO HAPPY I'M GONNA 'SPLODE!!

item.0: Wait, you don't have the Scratchcards? For Pete's sake, Vicky's dreams are in your hands, man! Get back out there! You need to hunt #rMelon Bubble Teas and collect #b60#k #rVIP Audition Scratchcards#k.
